KUTAA I — QAJEELEFAMA FAYYADAMAA

User Manual – Sirna Buusii Miseensaa Ji’aa

Dhaabbata

Giddu-gala Hifzii Qur’aanaa Al-Furqaan

Gosa sanadaa

Qajeelfama Fayyadamaa

Haala sanadaa

Qaboo-qora / hojii irra oolchuuf mirkaneessa barbaada

Guyyaa qopheessame

Sadaasa 2026


Seensa

Sanadni kun hojjettoota sirna Buusii Miseensaa Al-Furqaan fayyadaman gargaaruuf qophaa’e. Kaayyoon isaa miseensa galmeessuu, waadaa ji’aa hordofuu, kaffaltii fudhatame galmeessuu, dogoggora sirreessuu fi gabaasa qopheessuu irratti tartiiba hojii ifa ta’e kennuudha.

Hubachiisa haala hojii:  Qajeelfamni kun hojii fi amaloota sanada jalqabaa keessatti ibsaman irratti hundaa’a. Amaloonni kutaa 'Karoora fooyya’iinsaa' keessatti tarreeffaman hanga sirna irratti hojiirra oolanii mirkanaa’anitti karoora qofa.

 

1. Kaayyoo fi daangaa sirnichaa

Sirni kun miseensota deeggarsa ji’aa kennan galmeessuu, waadaa isaanii hordofuu, kaffaltii fudhatame qabachuu, haftee adda baasuu fi gabaasa qopheessuuf yaadame.

· Maallaqni hojii irra jiru Birrii Itoophiyaa (ETB) dha.

· Hanga maallaqaa lakkoofsa guutuun galchi; zeeroo ykn gatii negaatiivii hin galchin.

· Appiin maallaqa hin dabarsu; kaffaltii online hin fudhatu; baankii ykn wallet waliin ofumaan hin mirkaneessu.

· Kaffaltii dhugumaan fudhatame qofa galmeessi.

· Kaffaltiin haqame ykn fashale gabaasa keessatti hin lakkaa’amu.

· Ji’oota gara fuulduraa keessatti waadaan hojii irra jiru karoora ta’ee mul’achuu danda’a; yeroo darbe jedhamee hin lakkaa’amu.

2. Jalqaba hojii

1. Fuula websaayitii banuun seensa fayyadami. Yoo baate, deebitee seeni.

2. Sanduuqa ji’aa gubbaa irraa ji’a hojii sirrii filadhu.

3. Miseensa haaraa galmeessi; kaffaltii yeroo dhugumaan fudhatamu qofa galmeessi.

4. Guyyaa xumuraa ji’aa dura galmee miseensotaa fi kaffaltii hunda sakatta’i.

Qophii jalqabaa:  Odeeffannoo dhugaa galchuu dura miseensota, waadaa ji’aa, fayyadamtoota fi hayyama isaanii sirriitti qopheessi.

 

3. Miseensa galmeessuu

Fuula “Miseensota” irraa “Miseensa galmeessi” filadhu. Maqaa guutuun dirqama; bilbila, email fi naannoo yoo jiraate qofa galchi. Sirni lakkoofsa miseensaa adda ta’e ofumaan uuma jedhamee sanada jalqabaa keessatti ibsameera.

· Miseensi haaraan “Hojii irra” ta’ee galmee jalqabaa irraa eegalee waadaa qabaata.

· Miseensa ji’a gara fuulduraa jalqabsiisuu hin danda’amu; ji’i jalqabaa ji’a ammaa ykn darbe ta’a.

· Maqaa, lakkoofsa miseensaa ykn bilbila fayyadamuun barbaadi; calaltuu haala miseensummaa fayyadami.

4. Waadaa fi haala miseensummaa haaromsuu

Tarree miseensotaa keessatti buttonii gulaallii filadhu. Odeeffannoo quunnamtii, hanga waadaa ji’aa fi haala miseensummaa haaromsi. Sanada jalqabaa irratti jijjiiramni waadaa fi haalaa ji’a ammaa irraa hojii irra oola jedhamee ibsameera.

Waadaan ji’oota hojii irra jiraniif lakkaa’ama.

Yeroo dhaabbate

Deeggarsi yeroo murtaa’e dhaabbate.

Ji’a dhaabbachuun hojii irra oolutti eegalee waadaa haaraa hin ijaaru.

Xumurame

Miseensummaan dhaabbate.

Ji’a xumuraa irraa waadaa haaraa hin ijaaru; seenaa durii ni tura.

 

Yaada fooyya’iinsaa V2.0:  Waadaa jijjiirame durii irra hin barreessin. Guyyaa hojii irra oolu fi seenaa waadaa durii kuusi; kun gabaasa ji’oota darbee sirrii taasisa.

 

5. Kaffaltii galmeessuu

“Kaffaltii galmeessi” filachuun miseensa, ji’a kaffaltii, guyyaa maallaqni fudhatame, hanga kaffalame, mala kaffaltii fi wabii galchi.

Ji’a kaffaltii fi guyyaa kaffaltii adda:  Fakkeenyaaf kaffaltii Sadaasaaf Muddee 2 fudhatte: ji’a kaffaltii = Sadaasa; guyyaa fudhatame = Muddee 2.

 

· Kaffaltii muraasa yoo dhufe, hanga dhugumaan fudhatame galmeessi.

· Miseensi ji’oota durii irratti haftee qabaate, kaffaltii ji’a sirrii hafe jalatti galmeessi.

· Mala kaffaltii sirrii filadhu: harkaa, baankii, bilbila ykn mala dhaabbanni fayyadamu.

· Wabiin akka lakkoofsa nagahee, baankii ykn ragaa tajaajila bilbilaa fayyaduu danda’a.

· Kaffaltiin waadaa ol ta’e ji’a sana guutuu taasisa; ol darbe ji’a biraatti ofumaan hin dabarfamu.

6. Kaffaltii dogoggoraa sirreessuu

5. Galmee kaffaltii dogoggoraa keessaa “Fashalsiisi” filadhu.

6. Sababa gabaabaa fi ifa ta’e barreessi.

7. Galmeen durii hin haqamu; yeroo fashale fi sababni isaa seenaa keessatti tura.

8. Ji’a fi hanga sirrii waliin galmee kaffaltii haaraa uumi.

9. Gabaasa haaromsuun galmeen fashale keessaa akka hin lakkaa’amne mirkaneessi.

8. Gabaasa ji’aa fi waggaa

Gabaasa ji’aa keessatti waadaa yeroo sanaaf hojii irra jiru, kaffaltii galmaa’e, haftee fi haala miseensa tokkoon tokkoon ilaali. Gabaasa waggaa keessatti ji’oota 12, miseensota, waadaa, kaffaltii fi haftee ilaali.

· Miseensi waggaa keessa yoo seene, lakkaa’insi ji’oota hojii irra oole irraa eegala.

· Miseensi waggaa keessa yoo dhaabbate, ji’a dhaabbate irraa eegalee waadaa haaraa hin ijaaru.

· Kaffaltii fashale ykn sirreeffame gabaasa keessatti hin dabalin.

· Gabaasa erga qopheessitee booda ji’a fi bara filatame sirrii ta’uu mirkaneessi.

Tarree miseensotaa fi kaffaltii spreadsheet keessatti ilaali, calali ykn xiinxali.

 

Nageenya:  CSV tarree ilaaluuf faayidaa qaba; kuusaa database guutuu deebisee ijaaruuf backup miti. Gabaasa dhuunfaa bakka uummataaf banaa ta’etti hin maxxansin.

 

10. Nageenya fi gargaarsa

· Account kee nama biraaf hin qoodin; password cimaa fayyadami.

· Namni hojii irraa ba’e yoo jiraate, hayyama isaa yeroo sana keessa dhaabi.

· CSV, Word fi HTML bakka uummataaf banaa ta’etti hin maxxansin.

· Backup yeroo yeroon godhi; faayila backup bakka nageenya qabu keessatti kaa’i.

· Database hojii irra jiru kallattiin jijjiiruu hin yaalin; admin ykn nama ogummaa qabu qofaaf dhiisi.

· Rakkoo seensaa ykn shakkisiisaa yoo argite, password jijjiiri fi admin beeksisi.

KUTAA II — IMAAMMATA BULCHIINSAA FI MAALLAQAA

Administrative & Financial Policy – Buusii Miseensaa


 

Dhaabbata

Giddu-gala Hifzii Qur’aanaa Al-Furqaan

Gosa sanadaa

Imaammata Bulchiinsaa fi Maallaqaa

Haala sanadaa

Qaboo-qora / hojii irra oolchuuf mirkaneessa barbaada

Guyyaa qopheessame

Sadaasa 2026


1. Kaayyoo, daangaa fi seera waliigalaa

Imaammanni kun bulchiinsa miseensotaa, waadaa buusii ji’aa, fudhannaa kaffaltii, mirkaneessa, gabaasa, sirreeffama fi itti gaafatamummaa hojii Buusii Miseensaa Al-Furqaan irratti qajeelfama dhaabbataa kaa’uuf qophaa’e.

Haala raggaasisaa:  Qabiyyeen kun imaammata gorfamu V2.0 dha. Hojii irra oolchuuf hoggansa dhaabbataatiin mari’atamee ragga’uu qaba. Sanadni jalqabaa imaammata kana hunda akka seera dhaabbataatti hin mirkaneessu.

 

2. Bu’uuraalee hojii

· Dhugaa fi amanamummaa: galmeen hundi ragaa dhugaa irratti hundaa’uu qaba.

· Iftoomina: waadaa, kaffaltii, haftee fi sirreeffamni ifatti mul’achuu qaba.

· Seenaa eeguu: galmee maallaqaa durii haquu ykn dhoksuu hin qabu.

· Qoodinsa gahee: galmeessuu, mirkaneessuu fi odiitii hojii keessatti hamma danda’ametti adda baafamuu qaba.

· Iccitii: odeeffannoo miseensaa namoota hojii isaanii barbaachisu qofaaf kennuu.

· Itti gaafatamummaa: hojii maallaqaa hunda nama raawwate fi yeroo raawwate waliin galmeessuu.

3. Imaammata miseensummaa

3.1 Galmee miseensaa

· Maqaan guutuun dirqama; bilbila, email fi naannoo yoo jiraate galmeessuun ni danda’ama.

· Miseensa hundaaf ID addaa kan hin deddeebine kennamuu qaba.

· Guyyaan jalqabaa fi waadaan ji’aa galmee miseensaa keessatti kaa’amuu qaba.

· Odeeffannoo dhuunfaa hojii barbaachisu qofa walitti qabuu.

3.2 Haala miseensummaa

Haala

Hiika imaammataa

Murtii gabaasaa

Hojii irra

Miseensi buusii ji’aa kennuuf waliigaltee hojii irra jiru qaba.

Waadaa yeroo hojii irra jiruu qofa shallagi.

Yeroo dhaabbate

Deeggarsi yeroo murtaa’eef dhaabbate.

Guyyaa dhaabbannaa irraa eegalee waadaa haaraa hin ijaarin.

Xumurame

Miseensummaan dhaabbate.

Guyyaa xumuraa irratti waadaa dhaabi; seenaa durii tursiisi.

 

3.3 Jijjiirama waadaa

Gorfama V2.0: hanga buusii jijjiirame duraanii irratti barreessuun hin qabu. Galmee seenaa waadaa (commitment history) keessatti hanga durii, hanga haaraa, guyyaa hojii irra oolu, nama jijjiire fi sababaa galmeessi. Jijjiiramni haaraan yeroo murtaa’e irraa eegalee hojii irra haa oolu.

4. Imaammata kaffaltii

4.1 Raggaasisa kaffaltii

· Kaffaltii dhugumaan fudhatame qofa galmeessi.

· Ji’a kaffaltii fi guyyaa kaffaltiin itti fudhatame adda addaan galmeessi.

· Kaffaltiin muraasa hanga dhugumaan fudhatameen galmaa’a.

· Mala kaffaltii, ragaa/wabii fi nama fudhate galmeessi.

· Kaffaltiin waadaa ol ta’e gara ji’a biraatti ofumaan hin ramadamu; murtiin ramaddii dursee imaammataan ragga’uu qaba.

4.2 Haala kaffaltii gorfamu

Haala

Hiika

Gabaasa keessatti

Pending / Eegaa

Kaffaltiin dhiyaate, garuu hin mirkanoofne.

Waliigala kaffaltii mirkanaa’e keessatti hin dabalin.

Confirmed / Mirkanaa’e

Kaffaltiin ragaa irratti hundaa’ee fudhatame.

Waliigala kaffaltii keessatti dabal.

Cancelled / Fashale

Galmeen dogoggoraa ykn haqame; sababni isaa galmaa’e.

Waliigala irraa baas; audit trail tursiisi.

Rejected / Diddeebifame

Ragaan kaffaltii hin fudhatamne.

Waliigala kaffaltii keessatti hin dabalin.

Kaffaltii miseensa sirrii waliin walqabsiisuuf.

Ji’a waadaan itti ramadame.

Guyyaa fi yeroo fudhatame

Yeroo maallaqni dhugumaan fudhatame.

Hanga fi maallaqa

Haala fi sababaa

5. Sirna herrega fi shallaggii

Seera shallaggii:  Gabaasni waadaa yeroo sanatti hojii irra ture irratti hundaa’uu qaba. Waadaa ji’aa yeroo dheeraa keessatti jijjiirame yoo ta’e, ji’a tokko tokkoof hanga yeroo sanaaf hojii irra ture fayyadami.

 

Mallattoo

Foormulaa gorfamu

Hubachiisa

Waadaa eegamu (Expected)

Walitti qabama waadaa miseensotaaf ji’oota hojii irra oolan keessatti hojii irra ture.

Ji’a seensaa, dhaabbannaa fi jijjiirama waadaa ilaali.

Kaffaltii mirkanaa’e (Collected)

Walitti qabama kaffaltii haala Confirmed ta’e qofa.

Pending, Cancelled fi Rejected hin dabalin.

Haftee (Outstanding)

Waadaa eegamu − kaffaltii ji’a sanaaf ramadame.

Hafteen negaatiivii yoo ta’e ol-kaffaltii adda baasi.

Hirmaannaa % (Collection rate)

Kaffaltii mirkanaa’e ÷ waadaa eegamu × 100.

Waadaan eegamu zeeroo yoo ta’e N/A agarsiisi.

Ol-kaffaltii (Overpayment)

Kaffaltii ji’a sanaaf ramadame − waadaa ji’aa, yoo bu’aan pozatiivii ta’e.

Gara ji’a biraatti ofumaan hin dabarsin.

 

5.1 Fakkeenya shallaggii

Miseensi ETB 500 ji’aan waadaa gale; ji’oota Sadaasa, Muddee fi Amajjii keessatti miseensummaan hojii irra ture. Waadaan eegamu ETB 1,500 dha. Kaffaltii mirkanaa’e ETB 1,000 yoo ta’e, hafteen ETB 500, hirmaannaan 66.67% ta’a.

5.2 Seera ji’a fi bara

· Ji’a kaffaltii yeroo waadaan itti ramadameen murtaa’a; guyyaa maallaqni itti fudhatame irraa adda.

· Ji’oota gara fuulduraa karoora ta’uu danda’u; haftee yeroo darbe ta’anii hin lakkaa’aman.

· Miseensi bara keessa seene ji’oota waadaan hojii irra oole qofaaf shallagama.

· Miseensi dhaabbate ykn xumurame guyyaa hojii irra oole irratti hundaa’uun waadaa haaraa dhaaba.

6. Sirreeffama, fashalsuu fi audit trail

18. Galmee kaffaltii dogoggoraa haquu mannaa fashalsiisi ykn cancel godhi.

19. Sababni sirreeffamaa dirqama galmaa’uu qaba.

20. Galmeen durii, nama sirreesse, guyyaa fi yeroo sirreeffamaa tursiisi.

21. Galmee haaraa sirrii uumi; kaffaltii dogoggoraa lamaanuu gabaasa keessaa hin lakkaa’in.

22. Sirreeffamni baay’ee ykn hanga guddaa qabu nama aangoo qabuun ilaalamuu qaba.

7. Gahee fi itti gaafatamummaa

Gahee

Hayyama gorfamu

Daangaa

Super Admin / Owner

Fayyadamtoota, setting, integration, backup fi hayyama bulchuu.

Hojii hunda irratti audit log jiraachuu qaba.

Admin

Miseensa uumuu/gulaaluu, kaffaltii ilaaluu, gabaasa fi sirreeffama hayyamame bulchuu.

Setting nageenyaa fi account owner irratti daangaa qaba.

Cashier

Kaffaltii galmeessuu, ragaa maxxansuu fi nagahee kennuu.

Kaffaltii durii haquu ykn ofumaan mirkaneessuu hin qabu yoo qoodinsi gahee barbaachise.

Member

Odeeffannoo ofii ilaalu; ragaa kaffaltii dhiyeessuu.

Daataa miseensota biroo hin argu.

Viewer / Auditor

Gabaasa fi seenaa ilaaluu.

Galmee hin gulaalu.

 

Qoodinsa hojii:  Namni kaffaltii galmeessu fi namni kaffaltii mirkaneessu adda ta’uun filatama. Dhaabbanni nama muraasa qaba yoo ta’e, raggaasisa dabalataa ji’a xumura irratti kaa’i.

 

8. Cufiinsa ji’aa fi reconciliation

23. Galmee miseensotaa fi waadaa ji’aa ilaali.

24. Kaffaltii confirmed hunda nagahee, baankii ykn ragaa wallet waliin wal bira qabi.

25. Cash on hand fi bank/mobile money balance waliin waliigala sirnichaa wal bira qabi.

26. Kaffaltii pending, rejected, cancelled fi sirreeffama qoradhu.

27. Haftee miseensotaa fi ol-kaffaltii adda baasi.

28. Gabaasa ji’aa qopheessi; nama qopheesse, ilaale fi raggaase galmeessi.

29. Ji’a cufame irratti jijjiirama yoo barbaachise, hayyama addaa fi audit trail fayyadami.

9. Gabaasa fi qoodinsa odeeffannoo

· Gabaasni waliigalaa lakkoofsa miseensotaa, waadaa, kaffaltii, haftee fi hirmaannaa agarsiisa.

· Gabaasni maqaa miseensaa fi haftee dhuunfaa hayyama qabu qofatti daangeffama.

· Faayilota Word, PDF, HTML fi CSV bakka hayyamame qofa kaa’i.

· Linkii “Anyone with the link” fayyadamuun daataa miseensaa qooduu irraa of qusadhu.

· Gabaasa alatti erguun dura yeroo, lakkoofsa fi iccitii odeeffannoo mirkaneessi.

10. Nageenya, backup fi eegumsa daataa

Tooftaa

Imaammata gorfamu

Account

Account dhuunfaa; password cimaa; account wal-qooduu dhorkuu.

MFA

Two-factor authentication yoo tajaajilli deeggaru, keessumaa Admin/Super Admin.

Access review

Hayyama fayyadamtootaa yeroo yeroon ilaali; hojjetaan hojii irraa ba’e hatattamaan cufi.

Backup

Backup guyyuu ykn yeroo hojii irratti waliigalameen; encryption fi bakka addaatti kuusi.

Deebisanii banuu backup ji’a ji’aan ykn yeroo murtaa’een qoradhu.

Data retention

Yeroo daataa tursiifamu fi yeroo haquu seera biyyaafi imaammata dhaabbataatiin murteessi.

Technical Requirements & Acceptance Specification


 

Dhaabbata

Giddu-gala Hifzii Qur’aanaa Al-Furqaan

Gosa sanadaa

Qajeelfama Teeknikaa

Haala sanadaa

Qaboo-qora / hojii irra oolchuuf mirkaneessa barbaada

Guyyaa qopheessame

Sadaasa 2026


1. Kaayyoo fi haala sanadaa

Sanadni kun sirna Buusii Miseensaa Al-Furqaan fooyyessuuf fedhii hojii fi teeknikaa walitti qaba. Inni qajeelfama developer, tester, system administrator fi hoggansaaf ta’a.

Haala hojii:  Sanadni jalqabaa amaloota sirna amma jiru fi karoora fooyya’iinsaa walitti qaba. Kanaaf, requirement tokkoon tokkoon isaa haala Current / Planned / To be verified jedhuun adda baafameera. Sanadni kun ragaa implementation ykn security audit miti.

 

2. Haala sirna amma jiru fi daangaa

Amaloota sanada jalqabaa keessatti ibsame

Haala sanadaa

Miseensa galmeessuu, waadaa ji’aa, haala miseensummaa

Current workflow described; implementation must be verified.

Kaffaltii, ji’a kaffaltii, guyyaa fudhatame, mala fi wabii

Current workflow described; test against live system.

Kaffaltii fashalsuu fi seenaa sirreeffamaa

Current workflow described; audit behavior must be verified.

Gabaasa ji’aa/waggaa; Word, HTML, CSV

Documented capability; output accuracy to be tested.

Google Sign-In, Gmail reminder, WhatsApp/Telegram

Planned / integration required.

Google Drive/Sheets sync

Planned / OAuth and sync controls required.

Receipt PDF, evidence upload

Planned / acceptance testing required.

Role-based access control

Required design; exact implementation to be verified.

 

3. Stakeholders and user roles

Role

Use cases

Permission principle

Super Admin / Owner

System settings, users, integrations, backup, access control.

Full privileged access; all actions logged.

Admin

Members, commitments, payment oversight, reports.

Operational access; restricted security settings.

Cashier

Record payments, attach evidence, issue receipts.

Payment entry; no unrestricted deletion.

Member

View own profile and payment history; submit evidence if enabled.

Own-record access only.

Viewer / Auditor

Read reports and audit history.

Read-only.

 

4. Functional requirements

4.1 Membership

ID

Requirement

Acceptance evidence

MEM-01

Create member with required full name, start date and monthly commitment.

Required-field validation; successful save.

MEM-02

Generate unique, non-repeating member ID.

Create multiple records; verify no duplicate IDs.

MEM-03

Search by name, member ID and phone; filter by status.

Search/filter results match stored records.

MEM-04

Support Active, Paused and Ended membership statuses.

Status changes affect obligations from effective date.

MEM-05

Retain commitment history with effective-from date and editor.

Changing amount does not rewrite historical months.

MEM-06

Prevent future start date if current product rule remains unchanged.

Validation and user-facing error tested.

 

4.2 Payment and receipt

ID

Requirement

Acceptance evidence

PAY-01

Record member, contribution month, received date, amount, method and reference.

Saved transaction contains all required fields.

PAY-02

Assign unique payment transaction ID.

No duplicates under concurrent entry.

PAY-03

Support partial payments.

Outstanding balance recalculates correctly.

PAY-04

Support pending, confirmed, cancelled and rejected statuses.

Only confirmed transactions enter collected totals.

PAY-05

Cancel rather than delete erroneous transactions; require reason.

Original entry and cancellation event remain auditable.

PAY-06

Attach optional image/PDF evidence in restricted storage.

Authorized users only can access evidence.

REC-01

Generate unique receipt number and printable PDF.

Receipt includes institution, receipt ID, member ID/name, month, amount, method, date, receiver and confirmation.

REC-02

Allow receipt download and print; sharing only through authorized flow.

PDF layout and access control tested.

 

4.3 Financial calculations and reporting

ID

Requirement

Acceptance evidence

FIN-01

Calculate expected contributions per member and month using effective commitment history.

Join, pause, end and amount change cases pass.

FIN-02

Calculate collected amount from confirmed payments only.

Pending/cancelled/rejected excluded.

FIN-03

Calculate outstanding balance per member and month.

Partial and full payment cases match expected results.

FIN-04

Show overpayments separately; do not automatically carry forward.

Excess amount visible and not silently allocated.

FIN-05

Calculate collection rate as confirmed allocated payments / expected contributions × 100.

Zero expected amount displays N/A, not divide-by-zero.

REP-01

Monthly report: members, expected, collected, outstanding, rate and status detail.

Totals reconcile with transaction ledger.

REP-02

Annual report: monthly breakdown for selected year.

Twelve periods display correct calendar boundaries.

REP-03

Export PDF/Word/CSV and print-ready A4 layout.

Exported totals and filters match on-screen report.

REP-04

Separate aggregate report from confidential individual debt list.

Viewer permissions and export scope verified.

 

5. Financial data model – minimum entities

Entity

Important fields (minimum)

Relationship / rule

Member

member_id, full_name, phone, email, area, created_at

One member may have multiple status/commitment history entries.

MembershipStatusHistory

member_id, status, effective_from, effective_to, reason, changed_by

Preserve all historical status intervals.

CommitmentHistory

member_id, amount_etb, effective_from, effective_to, changed_by, reason

No overwriting past effective periods.

Payment

payment_id, member_id, contribution_period, received_at, amount_etb, method, reference, status, received_by

Each payment linked to one member and contribution period.

PaymentEvidence

evidence_id, payment_id, secure_storage_key, uploaded_by, uploaded_at

Optional; access controlled.

Receipt

receipt_id, payment_id, issued_at, issued_by, receipt_file_key

Receipt ID unique; reissue history recorded.

AuditEvent

event_id, actor_id, action, entity, entity_id, timestamp, before/after, reason

Append-only or tamper-evident.

User / Role

user_id, identity, role, status, last_login

Role controls actions and data scope.

 

6. Business rules and formulae

Rule ID

Business rule

BR-01

Expected contribution for a period is the sum of applicable member commitments for members whose membership is active in that period.

BR-02

If membership begins or ends during a month, the institution must approve whether the month is charged in full or prorated; system behavior must follow the approved policy.

BR-03

A paused membership creates no new obligation from the approved pause effective date; earlier obligations remain in history.

BR-04

A commitment change applies only from its effective month/date; prior months retain the former amount.

BR-05

Only confirmed payments count as collected.

BR-06

Payment date and contribution month are separate fields.

BR-07

Overpayment does not automatically transfer to another month unless a separate approved allocation workflow exists.

BR-08

Cancelled/rejected payments remain traceable but are excluded from totals.

BR-09

A closed period can only be amended by authorized role; changes require reason and audit event.

 

7. Dashboard and user interface

Widget

Definition

Active members

Count of members active for selected reporting period.

Expected contribution

Total obligation for the selected period, based on effective membership and commitment history.

Collected

Confirmed payment amount allocated to selected period.

Outstanding

Expected contribution minus eligible allocated payments; overpayments shown separately.

Collection rate

Collected / Expected × 100; N/A when expected is zero.

Overdue / delayed

Members with outstanding amounts for periods that have closed.

Trend chart

Monthly expected versus collected values.

Recent transactions

Latest payment entries with status, member, amount and date; permission-restricted.

Payment method mix

Confirmed totals grouped by payment method.

 

Interface requirements: Afaan Oromoo first; responsive layout for desktop and mobile; clear labels; visible selected period; consistent ETB formatting; validation messages; accessible contrast; confirmation before irreversible or sensitive actions.

8. Authentication, authorization and privacy

· Support secure login and logout; Google Sign-In is a planned option subject to OAuth setup and institutional account policy.

· Enforce server-side role checks; hiding a button in the interface is not sufficient authorization.

· Restrict member users to their own data.

· Use MFA for privileged accounts where supported.

· Use secure password storage and session management; never store plaintext passwords.

· Automatically revoke access when a staff member leaves or changes duties.

· Protect exports, receipts and evidence attachments; avoid public file links.

· Collect only information needed for membership administration and financial accountability.

9. Integrations

Integration

Purpose

Required controls

Gmail

Send authorized payment reminders or reports.

OAuth least privilege, recipient confirmation, send log, rate limits, opt-out/consent policy.

WhatsApp / Telegram

Share reminders or receipts where approved.

Verified official account/number, consent, template review, no public exposure of debt details.

Google Drive

Store approved exports/backups.

Restricted folders, owner account, encryption where available, retention and access review.

Google Sheets

Optional reporting/synchronization.

Database remains source of truth; idempotent sync, duplicate prevention, error log, access control.

Google Sign-In

Authenticate approved users.

Allowlist/domain policy, account linking safeguards, role assignment by admin.

 

10. Backup, recovery and operations

Control

Minimum recommended requirement

Automated backup

Daily database backup, plus frequency adjusted to transaction volume.

Backup security

Encrypt backups; restrict access; store a separate copy away from production.

Retention

Define daily/weekly/monthly retention with management approval.

Restore test

Perform documented restore test at least monthly and after major infrastructure changes.

Recovery objectives

Management and technical owner define acceptable data-loss window (RPO) and restoration time (RTO).

Monitoring

Monitor failed jobs, storage capacity, login anomalies and integration errors.

Incident response

Document who is notified, how access is suspended, how data is restored and how incidents are recorded.

 

11. Non-functional requirements

Area

Requirement

Reliability

Transactions must not be partially saved; errors must be visible and recoverable.

Performance

Common member search and monthly report should complete within an agreed service target under expected load.

Usability

Afaan Oromoo interface, consistent terminology, clear forms and helpful validation.

Compatibility

Current supported desktop browsers and responsive mobile view.

Data integrity

Use database constraints for unique IDs, valid amounts, relationships and transaction status.

Security

HTTPS, least privilege, secure file storage, audit trail and dependency updates.

Maintainability

Documented deployment, configuration, schema migrations and operational runbook.

Localization

ETB currency; institution-approved calendar handling; date conversion tested if both Ethiopian and Gregorian calendars are supported.

 

12. Test scenarios and acceptance checklist

Test ID

Scenario

Expected result

T-01

Register a member with valid required fields.

Member saved with unique ID.

T-02

Attempt duplicate member ID.

System prevents duplicate.

T-03

Member joins mid-year.

Only applicable months enter expected contribution.

T-04

Commitment changes from ETB 500 to ETB 1,000 effective January.

Earlier months remain ETB 500; January onward uses new amount.

T-05

Member pauses membership.

New obligations stop from approved effective date; prior balances remain.

T-06

Record ETB 200 against ETB 500 obligation.

Outstanding balance ETB 300.

T-07

Record pending payment.

Collected total does not increase.

T-08

Confirm pending payment.

Collected total increases once only.

T-09

Cancel incorrect payment with reason.

Original retained; totals exclude it.

T-10

Record ETB 700 against ETB 500 obligation.

Month is satisfied; ETB 200 shown as overpayment, not carried automatically.

T-11

Generate monthly and annual reports.

Totals reconcile to confirmed transaction ledger.

T-12

Member attempts to view another member's record.

Access denied.

T-13

Cashier attempts privileged settings change.

Access denied.

T-14

Restore a backup in test environment.

Data restored and validation documented.

T-15

Export a report.

Selected period, filters and totals are preserved.

Exit condition
